create_text_labels: create text labels from class IDs, scores, and class names for visualization output
draw_text_on_image: draw text at a specified position on an image using ImgVisualizer
draw_multiple_text_labels: draw multiple text labels around a bounding box using ImgVisualizer
draw_one_frame: draw predicted labels and bounding boxes on a single video frame
draw_clip_with_fading: draw bounding boxes and labels on a video clip with fade in and out effect
